email.body1:
Gustavo, saw BizzyCar raised another $20M and is heading toward nearly 1,000 dealers on the mobile service platform.

Scaling dealers that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that gap is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for BizzyCar off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Gustavo, quick follow-up for BizzyCar.

Post-raise, the pipeline target usually jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings BizzyCar needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Gustavo, last bit of proof for BizzyCar.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how BizzyCar's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
